segments.name: Cloud-based Platform
segments.description: Cloud-based work management platform enabling humans and AI agents to collaborate on mission-critical workflows.
segments.evidence: The Company primarily generates revenues from subscriptions from paying customers accessing its cloud-based platform.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay subscription fees for tiered seat-based access to the cloud-based work management platform.
revenueModel.evidence: Our core work management product is available in a tiered, seat-based model: Personal, Starter, Advanced, Enterprise, and Enterprise+.
